name: agent-dev-slide
description: agent-dev-template の開発プロセスを説明するスライド

scripts.check:links: markdown-link-check --quiet --ignore docs/decisions/0000-template.md --config .markdown-link-check.json README.md AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md docs slides
scripts.build:samples: marp --no-stdin --allow-local-files -I slides/samples -o dist/samples && marp --no-stdin --allow-local-files --pdf -I slides/samples -o dist/samples && node -e "require('node:fs').cpSync('slides/samples', 'dist/samples', { recursive: true, filter: (f) => !f.endsWith('.md') })"
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run check:links && npm run check:guides && npm run build && npm run build:pdf
